Singakwazi ukwandisa iwindi lememory (elibizwa nge-context size) ukuze ikhumbule okuningi, kodwa kungase kusebenzise imemori eminingi yekhompyutha yakho. uploadFailed.pdfMalformedXref: {{subject}} ine-tafula yokudlulisela engalungile ye-PDF futhi ayikwazi ukuhunyushwa. Zama ukuyivula ku-PDF viewer bese uyigcina kabusha (Ifayela → Printa → Londoloza njenge-PDF), bese uyilayisha futhi.
uploadFailed.pdfScanned: Kubukeka sengathi {{subject}} iyi-PDF eskenwe noma esuselwa esithombeni. I-OCR ayisekeliwe okwamanje — sicela ulayishe i-PDF esekelwe embhalweni.
uploadFailed.pdfEncrypted: {{subject}} ivikelwe ngephasiwedi. Susa iphasiwedi bese uzama futhi.
uploadFailed.pdfUnsupportedFeature: {{subject}} isebenzisa isici se-PDF esingakakwazi ukuhunyushwa yi-Novera okwamanje (isb. Imisebenzi yombala/umthunzi ye-PostScript). Zama ukuyigcina kabusha (Ifayela → Printa → Londoloza njenge-PDF) ukuze uyibeke phansi, bese uyilayisha futhi.
uploadFailed.pdfGeneric: {{subject}} ayikwazi ukuhunyushwa njenge-PDF. Ifayela lingase labe selonakala noma lisebenzisa isici se-PDF esingasekelwa.

sandbox.title: Ukusebenzisa imiyalo kuvaliwe
sandbox.body: Novera ivumela i-agent ukuthi iqhube imiyalo ye-shell kuphela uma uhlelo lwakho lungakwazi ukuyivimbela. Alukho uhlelo lokuvikela lapha, ngakho i-agent ingafunda, ibhale futhi ihlele amafayela ku-sandbox yayo — kodwa ayikwazi ukuqhubisa lutho.
sandbox.fixLinux: Linux isebenzisa i-bubblewrap. Faka yona, bese uqala kabusha i-Novera.
sandbox.fixMac: macOS isebenzisa i-sandbox esakhelwe ngaphakathi ku /usr/bin/sandbox-exec. Qala kabusha i-Novera uma isitholakala.
sandbox.fixWindows: Windows isebenzisa i-AppContainer. Qala kabusha i-Novera ukuzama futhi.
